pages.title: The Dragon Panel
pages.text: With empty hands, Shift-right-click your dragon to check its condition. Armor and accessories are under Dragon Equipment; open Knowledge Level to help it learn.

pages.title: Accessory Slots
pages.text: Dragon Equipment has three accessory slots. Knowledge levels one, two, and three unlock them from top to bottom.$(br2)Before the first slot opens, turn to $(l:dragonmaid:learning/books)Lessons and Lore$(/l).

pages.title: Keeping Equipment
pages.text: Each knowledge level opens another row in your companion’s pack, up to three rows. Dragon Equipment shows your inventory beside your companion's pack, ready to pass things over.$(br2)You can have it gather everything, nothing, or only items already in the pack. A fight comes first.

pages.title: Sword and Shield
pages.text: At knowledge level two, a melee weapon adds to your humanoid companion’s strength and reaches farther. An off-hand shield lets it block and counter.$(br2)It puts both away to rest or sleep, then takes them up again. After battle, check blade and shield for wear.

pages.title: Pack a Lunch
pages.text: Below 80 hunger or short of full health, your dragon takes meat or an ordinary Dragon Meal from the first suitable slot. Put its next lunch up front. It eats more often in a fight and leaves Creative and Sickly Meals alone.
Feed a critically injured friend by hand. After maturity, shed scales go into the pack and any excess falls at its feet.

pages.title: Armor and Healing
pages.text: A $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/warding_emblem)Warding Emblem$(/l) grants armor; a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/natural_dragon_heart_necklace)Natural Dragon Heart Necklace$(/l) helps restore health. The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/dragon_heart_emblem_necklace)Dragon Heart Emblem Necklace$(/l) combines both effects.$(br2)Obtaining any ingredient unlocks the matching accessory page.

pages.title: Breath Enhancement
pages.text: The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/dragon_breath_emblem)Dragon Breath Emblem$(/l) improves human-form combat breath. Fire and ice dragons have shorter pauses between bursts; lightning dragons can breathe for longer.

pages.title: Type-Specific Gear
pages.text: Prepare a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/lightning_discharge_device)Lightning Discharge Device$(/l) for a lightning dragon, a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/steaming_drink)Steaming Drink$(/l) for a fire dragon, or an $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/icy_drink)Icy Drink$(/l) for an ice dragon.$(br2)Each fits only its matching type and strengthens the direct damage of human-form combat breath.

pages.title: Combining Effects
pages.text: The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/ultimate_dragon_breath_device)Ultimate Dragon Breath Device$(/l) combines four breath accessories in one slot and fits all three dragon types.$(br2)Armor bonuses can stack; accessories with other identical benefits cannot be worn together.

pages.title: Roars and Barbs
pages.text: The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/majesty_eye_pendant)Eye of Majesty$(/l) strengthens a dragon's roar. The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/thornfeather_charm)Thornfeather Charm$(/l) answers an attacker when its wearer is wounded.

pages.title: Venom and Frost
pages.text: Fire dragons can wear the $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/venomfang_pendant)Venomflame Heart$(/l) for poison and healing through melee combat. The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/frosty_tail_fin)Frosttide Tail Fin$(/l) gives ice dragons a heavier tail sweep that slows enemies.

pages.title: The Close Hunt
pages.text: Choose the $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/wild_pendant)Wild Pendant$(/l) for more sustained close combat in human form, or $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/rending_claw)Rending Claw$(/l) for greater reach. Both strengthen melee attacks in either form, but cannot be worn together.

pages.title: Two Charms in One
pages.text: The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/guardian_thornfeather_emblem)Warding Thornfeather Emblem$(/l) combines armor with retaliation. The $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/hunter_king_pendant)Hunter King Pendant$(/l) unites the $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/wild_pendant)Wild Pendant$(/l) and $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/rending_claw)Rending Claw$(/l). Each saves a slot while retaining its components' equipment restrictions.

pages.title: Before Moving On
pages.text: Nearby items allowed by the pickup mode enter the pack. While idle, your companion also walks over to collect them; after battle, it may gather nearby drops before returning.$(br2)Horns and recall altars preserve its pack, held equipment and knowledge.
